title: Object Storage: outage authorize — remaining original-payment payment remainder
content:
For Object Storage outage authorize, for this procedure the target source invoice has exactly one completed original payment; take the magnitude of that source-linked payment and subtract only posted refunds and returns linked to its payment identifier, then floor at zero. Earlier fully settled invoices do not contribute payment remainder to this payment. A target invoice with several original payments remains under the base allocation procedure.

## Basis Q&A

What determines outage authorize in this situation? For this procedure the target source invoice has exactly one completed original payment; take the magnitude of that source-linked payment and subtract only posted refunds and returns linked to its payment identifier, then floor at zero. Earlier fully settled invoices do not contribute payment remainder to this payment. A target invoice with several original payments remains under the base allocation procedure.

## Hypothetical outage authorize — remaining original-payment payment remainder case

For this outage authorize — remaining original-payment payment remainder example, assume a hypothetical original source payment of USD 210, with USD 18 of posted refunds and USD 12 of posted returns linked to that payment. Remaining payment remainder is USD 180. A fully settled earlier invoice does not add its payment payment remainder to this amount.
